s10.old: - **Web research for company ambiguity (Paul 2026-07-19, verbatim: "if you are ever ambigous on a company just check via codex on the internet."):** when an employer string might be the roster company or an unrelated firm sharing the name, do NOT guess and do NOT default to asking Paul; dispatch Codex to research it on the web (network is OFF by default in the sandbox and MUST be enabled explicitly; command in Dev Commands). Give Codex the corroborating FEC evidence - **state and occupation strings are the decisive signals**. Ask for a verdict table with an evidence URL per row, and instruct it to be conservative (UNCERTAIN over a guess). Real example that worked: bare `GEMINI` in NH with occupations CNC PROGRAMMER / SIGNS is a sign manufacturer, not the NY crypto exchange. The resulting verdicts go into `inputs/company_match_overrides.csv` (employer_key, company, decision), which persists across runs. Paul picks the roster; research only ever disambiguates *within* companies he already listed, it never adds new ones (see `mentat-roster-and-culling-rules-2026-07-19`).
s10.why: "see `mentat-roster-and-culling-rules-2026-07-19`" names a memory file outside the family

s10.old: - **Never supervise long jobs from an AI turn** (Incident below). A long-running Python job is finished when its receipt/status file says so, not when a model has watched it finish: launch it detached (Task Scheduler, `Start-Process`), then use ONE Bash `run_in_background` `until` loop or one `Monitor` on the status file. Never a per-turn poll loop, never `wait`/`sleep` turns, never spawn helper agents to "watch".

s10.old: - **Reflex layer 2026-07-23 (Paul: "Codex can have reflexes per say, immediate corrections that it overrides and that sends to claude for confirmation" + a pasted BRAIN-BODY REFLEX PROTOCOL; he REJECTED the WebFetch of the noba/NCBI nervous-system articles and handed the distilled contract directly - do not re-fetch). SHIPPED @8dcf330** (main == live == user-scope synced md5-identical; SKILL.md 184 -> 365 lines): bidirectional afferent/efferent framing + `## Reflex layer (body-before-brain)`: Codex may act BEFORE deliberation only to prevent immediate observable harm (pause/contain/preserve only), then halts and leads with a REFLEX REPORT; Claude replies CONFIRM/MODIFY/ROLLBACK/ESCALATE. **The anti-loophole clause is the load-bearing part** - harm is not ambiguity (ambiguity -> STOP, change nothing); "correct a clear execution error" = Codex's OWN mechanical slip in the current turn ONLY, never a defect it perceives in the spec or pre-existing code; plan-only rounds reduce the reflex to halt-and-report, never writes. **The plan-echo gate proved its worth on first real use**: Codex-as-sensor flagged 5 conflicts + 5 ambiguities, three of which changed the design - including that the drafted claim "Claude is structurally guaranteed to see every reflex report" was FALSE (idle-timeout can lose the response), fixed to "loses the report but NOT the containment -> after any lost turn Claude inspects the worktree and treats unexplained state as an unreported reflex."
